1013.name: Baikal Splendor
1013.description: For the next 3s, every basic attack has a 80% chance to deal additional DMG to the target (Damage Factor 4500).

1013.name: Raging Blood
1013.description: Increases Squad Capacity by 12% and Rally Capacity by 12%.

1013.name: Bloodthirst
1013.description: If there are 2 or more types of troops in the Squad, increases Squad ATK by 24%.

1013.name: Drunken Rage
1013.description: Increases Squad DEF by 15% during Siege. Also increases DMG dealt to Lookout Towers by 30%.

1013.name: Wartime
1013.description: For the next 3s, every basic attack has a 100% chance to deal additional DMG to the target (Damage Factor 4500).

1033.name: Fire Eating Grenade
1033.description: Deals direct DMG (Damage Factor: 4500) to target, and causes Burn DMG for the next 5s (Damage Factor: 900). Deals bonus DMG to Garrison Squads (Damage Factor: 3500).

1033.name: Gunfire Symphony
1033.description: Increases DMG dealt to Lookout Towers by 30% during Siege. Also increases the amount of resources raided by 10%.

1033.name: Sinful Pleasure
1033.description: Squads' basic attacks have 10% chance to deal bonus DMG (Damage Factor: 3200) during Siege.

1033.name: Grenade Toss
1033.description: Increases Squad Capacity by 12% and Rally Capacity by 12%.

1033.name: Explosive Tempo
1033.description: Basic attacks have 10% chance to reduce target's DMG by 8% and DEF by 20% for 3s.

1036.name: Brutal Blow
1036.description: Pitches a spinning fastball, dealing DMG to up to 5 target Squads in a fan-shaped area in front (Damage Factor: 3800). Reduces targets' ATK, DEF, and HP by 30% for 2s.

1036.name: Energized
1036.description: Increases Squads' DMG dealt to Zombies by 25%. Heals some Lightly Wounded units after killing Zombies [color=#25%](Heal Factor: 3800).

1036.name: Baseball Star
1036.description: When leading 2 or more troop types, increases Squad ATK by 24%.

1036.name: Countercurrent Swing
1036.description: Reduces Counter DMG taken by 14%, and increases Rally Capacity by 12%.

1036.name: Death Home Run
1036.description: Pitches a spinning fastball, dealing DMG to up to 5 target Squads in a fan-shaped area in front (Damage Factor: 4600). Reduces targets' ATK, DEF, and HP by 35% for 2s.

1040.name: Hometown Nostalgia
1040.description: Increases Squad ATK by 45% and DEF by 45%, and gains an additional 20 Rage Points from each basic attack. Lasts 5s.

1040.name: Harmony First
1040.description: Reduces Squads' DMG taken by 7.5%. Also has 10% chance of healing when DMG is taken [color=#7.5%](Heal Factor: 1500). This effect can be triggered only once in 6s.

1040.name: Earthly Desire
1040.description: Increases Rally Capacity by 15%. Also increases DMG dealt by Squad by 11% during Siege.

1040.name: Breach of Trust
1040.description: Increases Squad ATK by 18% and DEF by 18%.

1040.name: Storm Command
1040.description: Increases Squad ATK by 55% and DEF by 55%, and gains an additional 25 Rage Points from each basic attack. Lasts 5s.

1061.name: End's Awakening
1061.description: Deals DMG to the enemy (Damage Factor 8000, reduced to 4000 when acting as Vice-General). At the same time, reduces DEF of the attacked Squad by 25% for 3s.

1061.name: Desperate Escape
1061.description: Increases DMG dealt to Zombies by 25%. When attacking a Zombie, there is a 10% chance to heal Lightly Wounded Squads by [color=#25%](Heal Factor: 1500).

1061.name: Omen of Disaster
1061.description: When using a basic attack, there is a 20% chance to reduce Skill DMG taken by 25% for 3s.

1061.name: Zombie Herding
1061.description: Increases Squad ATK by 12% and DEF by 12%.

1061.name: Wasteland Eulogy
1061.description: Deals DMG to the enemy (Damage Factor 9600, reduced to 4800 when acting as Vice-General). At the same time, reduces DEF of the attacked Squad by 30% for 3s.

1090.name: Body Weapon
1090.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 12500). If garrisoning, increases this skill's DMG by 15%.

1090.name: Evolutionary Leader
1090.description: Increases own Squad ATK by 17%, and increases Squad HP by 17%.

1090.name: Supervisor Privileges
1090.description: Reduces Skill DMG taken by 17%. When Squad contains 2 or more types of Troops, increases Squad ATK by 20%.

1090.name: Survival of the Fittest
1090.description: When garrisoning, increases Squad HP by 20%. Basic attacks have a 20% chance to deal additional DMG to the target [color=#20%](Damage Factor: 1920).

1090.name: Natural Evolution
1090.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 13750). If garrisoning, increases this skill's DMG by 20%.

1091.name: Queen's Troops
1091.description: Increases ATK by 38% and DEF by 38% for you and nearby allies. Lasts 4s. Also instantly restores 60 Rage to them. Affects up to 3 Squads.

1091.name: Queen's Trap
1091.description: Increases Squad DEF by 24% and Travel Speed by 20%.

1091.name: Queen vs Pawn
1091.description: Increases Squad ATK by 20%. Increases basic attack DMG by 20% if the remaining Squad Size is less than 50%.

1091.name: Queen's Defense
1091.description: Every 10s, grants a Shield (Shield Factor: 2800) to you and nearby allies. Lasts 3s. Affects up to 3 Squads.

1091.name: Queen's Gambit
1091.description: Increases ATK by 42% and DEF by 42% for you and nearby allies. Lasts 4s. Also instantly restores 60 Rage to them. Affects up to 5 Squads.

1106.name: Blossoming Life
1106.description: Reduces Skill DMG taken by 20% for 4s, and grants a status to self and nearby allies. Increases the target's DMG by 25% for 4s if their remaining Squad Size is greater than 50%. When the target's Squad Size is less than 50%, heal Lightly Wounded Squads [color=#20%](Heal Factor: 3000) and reduces their DMG taken by 15% for 4s. Affects up to 5 Squads.

1106.name: Lingering Miasma
1106.description: After using a Rage Skill, reduces HP and TRVL SPD of up to 5 enemies by 30% and 40% respectively for 3s.

1106.name: Spore Parasitism
1106.description: Increases Squad HP by 20%, TRVL SPD by 20%, and Squad Capacity by 10%.

1106.name: Photosynthetic Assimilation
1106.description: Reduces Counter DMG taken by 20%. When taking Skill DMG, gains a Shield [color=#20%](Shield Factor: 3000) for 2s. This effect can be triggered only once in 6s.

1106.name: Decay and Wither
1106.description: After using a Rage Skill, reduces HP and TRVL SPD of up to 5 enemies by 35% and 40% respectively for 3s. Also, reduces their Rage Recovery Speed by 20% during this time.

1114.name: Grand Opening
1114.description: Deals DMG to the current target (Damage Factor: 14000). When not Rallying or Garrisoned, increases DMG received by 3 nearby enemy Squads by 10% for 3s.

1114.name: Lead the Trend
1114.description: Squad ATK increases by 30%, and Travel Speed increases by 15%.

1114.name: Intimidating Stance
1114.description: When not Rallying or Garrisoned, increases Squad HP by 30%. When Flanked, reduces Skill DMG taken by 8%.

1114.name: Deadly Elegance
1114.description: When not Rallying or Garrisoned, increases Skill DMG by 20%, and gains 30 Rage every 10s.

1114.name: Couture Gala
1114.description: When serving as Leader and not Rallying or Garrisoned, gains additional effects based on the type of Squad led. Infantry-only Squad: Using "Grand Opening" increases Squad DMG by 3% for 20s. This effect stacks up to 5 times, and remains active when out of combat. Rider-only Squad: "Grand Opening" deals bonus DMG [color=#3%](Damage Factor: 3500) to 2 other nearby targets. Ranged-only Squad: Increases the DMG of "Grand Opening" by 20%.

1123.name: Precision Volley
1123.description: Deals DMG to the target (Damage Factor: 12000) and increases ATK of up to 3 nearby allies by 20% for 3s.

1123.name: Graceful Steps
1123.description: Squad ATK increases by 30%, and Travel Speed increases by 15%.

1123.name: Glorious Command
1123.description: Increases Squad DEF by 30%. Increases Skill DMG by 15% when flanking the enemy.

1123.name: Blade of the Heavens
1123.description: Increases Squad HP by 20%. Basic attacks have a 20% chance to deal additional DMG to the target [color=#20%](Damage Factor: 2000).

1123.name: Desert Leader
1123.description: Increases Shelter Construction Speed by 15%. This effect applies even when not deployed.
